UFGA8201.MZX uses the existing scenarios fixture's treatments, fields and
planting. Its SIMULATION CONTROLS is copied from C:/DSSAT48/Maize/UFGA8201.MZX
(installed DSSAT 4.8 sample), including METHODS, MANAGEMENT, OUTPUTS and all
five AUTOMATIC MANAGEMENT blocks. It is a focused fixture, not a runnable
standalone DSSAT experiment.

Confirmed against the installed 4.8 Help/DSSAT_Input_Files.chm,
experimentfiles.htm and hmpopup_html.js: SDATE is year + day of year;
FROPT is frequency of output in days. SIMULATION.CDE lists Y/N switches.
Column positions (one-based, including left padding, from header token ends):
N: 1-2; GENERAL/SDATE: 33-38; OPTIONS/WATER: 11-20;
OPTIONS/NITRO: 21-26; OUTPUTS/FROPT: 33-38; TREATMENTS/SM: 71-73.
The wide first field includes the unused gap after the two-letter block code.
Every other byte in a copied controls row is retained, including that code.
